newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae supermarkets boost turnover Q1.
newsitem.headline: Sonae supermarkets boost turnover Q1.

text.p: Sonae Investimentos said that its supermarkets and hypermarkets boosted turnover in the first quarter of 1997 by 9.6 percent to 86 billion escudos.
The figure excludes exchange rate fluctuations between the Portuguese and Brazilian currencies.
It said turnover of Modelo Continente was 65 billion escudos, up 6.8 percent.
The group said it was sticking to its earlier forecast for consolidated sales to grow 15-20 percent in the full year.
